# Appy Pie Automate

> A no-code AI-powered workflow automation platform that connects 500+ apps through pre-built integrations and triggers-actions workflows.

Appy Pie Automate enables businesses to automate repetitive tasks without coding by integrating popular tools like Gmail, Google Sheets, HubSpot, PayPal, and ChatGPT. The platform serves various industries including e-commerce, CRM, healthcare, and fitness management with customizable automation templates and a comprehensive app directory.

## Key Topics

- Workflow Automation
- No-Code Automation
- App Integrations
- CRM Integration
- Business Automation
- Triggers & Actions
- App Directory

- Email Automation
- Third-Party Apps
- Automation Templates
- ChatGPT Integration
- HubSpot
- Google Sheets
- PayPal
